title: HDI Deployer undeploy allowlist (undeploy.json)
description: Top-level array of the design-time files the HDI Deployer may undeploy. Paths are relative to the root of the db/ module and use '/' as the delimiter (docs/specs/artifacts/artifact-registry.md).

items.patternErrorMessage: Use a path relative to the db/ module root with '/' delimiters, for example "src/Table.hdbtable".
items.description: Design-time file to undeploy, for example "src/Table.hdbtable".
